stories.summary: India has introduced three homegrown AI models, EKA-1, Dhir 2B and Dhir 5B, under the IndiaAI Mission. Two of the models are designed to run offline on smartphones and laptops. The government says the initiative aims to build domestic capabilities and reduce reliance on foreign technology.

stories.summary: Ricursive Intelligence has released Ripple-65B, a 65B parameter dense open-weight model pretrained for agentic coding. The company claims a score of 80.52 on Terminal-Bench 2.1, noting it outperforms rivals with significantly higher parameter counts. The model supports up to 1M context and runs on datacenter GPUs.

stories.summary: webAI has released TwIL-8B, an 8.8B parameter reasoning model post-trained from IBM’s Granite 4.2. The company says the model leads its size class on math and code benchmarks, including a 98.2 score on MATH-500. The weights are available under a non-commercial license.

stories.title: Gemini for Home integrates with AT&T security
stories.summary: AT&T’s Connected Life security system now integrates with Google Home Premium to provide Gemini-powered features. The system can summarize home events and allow users to search recorded video footage using natural language. AT&T says it is the first home security product to feature this integration.

stories.title: SEBI and BHASHINI partner for multilingual investor education
stories.summary: The Securities and Exchange Board of India has partnered with the Digital India BHASHINI Division to use AI for improving access to financial information. The agreement aims to address communication barriers for investors who prefer regional languages. The regulator is now exploring how to automate its own explanations.

stories.title: India flags AI hacking campaign targeting financial firms
stories.summary: India’s cybersecurity agency has identified a hacking group called Crafty Falcon, which uses AI to breach fintech firms and cryptocurrency exchanges. The agency issued an advisory following a series of recent attacks. The group’s origin and location remain unknown to the authorities.

stories.title: Cybersecurity agency warns of AI-driven payment system attacks
stories.summary: India’s Computer Emergency Response Team has warned that the AI-powered hacking group Crafty Falcon is targeting internal payment systems at financial companies. The group reportedly times its attacks for weekends and holidays. Exchanges have been urged to increase monitoring while staffing is thin.

stories.title: AI expected to shift India office demand by 2030
stories.summary: A study by Cushman and Wakefield projects India’s office-using workforce will grow to 48 million by 2030. The report suggests AI will change the nature of office demand rather than reduce it, as companies shift toward higher-value activities. Routine tasks are expected to be automated.

stories.title: Cognizant study models AI productivity gains for India
stories.summary: Cognizant estimates AI could add 28 billion to 84 billion USD to India’s annual GDP, depending on adoption rates. The study also noted that most business leaders have not yet seen financial returns from their AI investments. Theoretical ceilings are not forecasts.

stories.title: Report links AI to potential 79 billion dollar economic boost
stories.summary: An analysis by Ayre Think Tank suggests AI could add 79 billion dollars to India’s economy over the next decade. The report highlights India’s large youth population and high enthusiasm for AI tools. Over 60 per cent of young Indians feel confident managing their interactions with AI.

stories.title: Vyoma.AI begins construction on Chennai data center
stories.summary: Vyoma.AI has broken ground on a 52 MW data center in Chennai designed for high-density AI workloads. The facility will use direct-to-chip liquid cooling and renewable energy. It is part of a planned gigawatt-scale campus intended to serve hyperscalers and AI developers.

stories.title: Sportal Corporate adds AI-integrated sports degrees
stories.summary: Sportal Corporate is partnering with Mind Power University to launch AI-integrated sports degree programmes. The initiative aims to connect higher education with the professional requirements of the sports industry. Admissions for the new courses open for the 2027 academic session.

stories.title: Venomics AI secures 2.7 million dollars in pre-seed funding
stories.summary: Biotechnology startup Venomics AI has raised 2.7 million dollars to expand its molecular dataset of venom-derived compounds. Spun out of the Indian Institute of Science, the company uses AI to identify potential therapeutic applications. It plans to use the capital to strengthen its laboratory screening capabilities.

stories.title: Bio-tech startup Venomics AI raises $2.7 Mn in pre-seed round
stories.summary: Venomics AI, a biotechnology company spun out of the Indian Institute of Science (IISc), has raised $2.7 million in its first institutional funding round. stories.title: altM raises 10.3 million dollars for bio-based chemicals
stories.summary: Specialty chemicals startup altM has raised 10.3 million dollars in a Series A funding round led by Rainmatter and Mela Ventures. The Bengaluru-based company plans to use the capital to expand manufacturing capacity and commercialize its bio-based industrial chemicals.

stories.title: Kabilio raises 10 million euros for AI accounting agent
stories.summary: Barcelona-based Kabilio has closed a 10 million euro funding round to deploy its AI accounting platform. The startup aims to automate repetitive paperwork for accounting firms. The founder noted that nobody becomes an accountant to chase receipts, yet that is where time is lost.

stories.title: Simulacra raises pre-seed round for digital twin models
stories.summary: Tokyo-based Simulacra has raised an undisclosed pre-seed round to build AI models that replicate human behavior. The startup aims to combine thousands of these digital twins to simulate whole organizations and societies. The goal is to let governments test policies before rolling them out.

stories.title: Conlio raises 6.4 million euros to automate freight finance
stories.summary: German startup Conlio has raised 6.4 million euros to automate document verification and invoicing for freight forwarders. The company claims its AI platform automates more than 90 percent of these processes. The funding will support the firm's expansion across Europe.

stories.title: Nvidia chips sit idle in Hong Kong
stories.summary: Approximately 600,000 of Nvidia's H200 AI processors are currently stored in Hong Kong, according to Reuters. The chips are awaiting shipment to mainland China, but Beijing has not yet approved the large-scale imports. The hardware remains a short distance from its destination.

stories.title: SpaceX targets 10 gigawatts of data center capacity
stories.summary: Elon Musk claims SpaceX could build 10 gigawatts of data center capacity in 2027 alone. Analysts at Semiaccurate suggest the target is realistic if the company can scale its infrastructure rapidly. This would represent a significant increase over the 3 gigawatts of capacity the company currently maintains.

stories.title: AMD data center revenue reaches $8.5 billion
stories.summary: AMD reported a 97 percent year-on-year increase in data center revenue, reaching $8.5 billion for the third quarter of 2026. The company attributes the growth to demand for its EPYC server processors and Instinct GPUs. Total quarterly revenue rose 45 percent to $13.38 billion.

stories.summary: Schneider Electric has launched a prefabricated modular data center design intended for high-density AI workloads. The system is built to support the Nvidia Vera Rubin platform and aims to replace bespoke construction with repeatable layouts. The company says operators are shifting toward these pre-engineered blueprints to meet demand.

stories.title: UAE employees report high AI usage and job loss anxiety
stories.summary: Research from the Oliver Wyman Forum indicates 85 percent of UAE employees use AI at work, while 67 percent worry about job losses. Despite high adoption rates and investment in the stock market, only 25 percent of respondents report feeling fulfilled in their current roles.

stories.title: Smartsheet releases vsActual to link strategy and execution
stories.summary: Smartsheet has launched vsActual, an AI-native product intended to bridge the gap between enterprise strategy and daily operations. The tool pulls data from systems including Oracle, SAP, and Salesforce to address manual reporting delays. It aims to connect work that is currently spread across disconnected tools.

stories.title: GemDB introduces Visual Studio Code extension
stories.summary: GemDB has launched a free Visual Studio Code extension that allows developers and AI agents to modify application data models without separate migration steps. The tool uses application objects as the database schema, aiming to solve the problem of parallel updates required for traditional relational databases.

stories.title: Cognizant creates 25,000-person OpenAI group
stories.summary: Cognizant has formed an OpenAI Frontier Capability Group of 25,000 professionals to support enterprise clients using ChatGPT and Codex. The initiative focuses on software engineering, application modernization, and the integration of AI agents into sales and support. Over 21,000 employees have undergone related training.

stories.title: Canva cuts 1,271 jobs amid restructuring
stories.summary: Canva is reducing its workforce by 22 percent as the company faces its slowest growth in a decade. CEO Melanie Perkins announced the restructuring, which includes severance packages featuring six months of pay, $10,000 grants, and LinkedIn Premium. The company is adjusting to rising AI costs.
